公共参数绑定到derived表时继承整表只读；共同字段定义可写不覆盖目标表权限。
菜单多选参数的值为已登记menu_option引用集合；此编码是本轮选择模型，不冒充原宿主wire。
Excel只提供表单与静态校验，不宣称实现动态注册引擎或执行应用。
operation=set且value_state=known且value_type非null时，恰填一个匹配类型值格，或按唯一真源规则填写existing_value_ref；二者不得同时有值。
value_type=null仅在参数定义nullable明确true且value_state=known时允许；所有typed值格与existing_value_ref均为空，不另造null文本。
operation=clear/unset/inherit不携带typed值或existing_value_ref；目标坐标用于标明操作对象，不是值。

rules.single_truth: Original migrated text fields are projections/instructions; writable truth is the linked child record only.
rules.unknown: Blank is not zero; no arithmetic coercion of unknown/unset/not_applicable.
rules.scope: Child records inherit parent world/session/branch, record status and permissions; referenced targets do not grant knowledge.
rules.nesting: Flat keyed records plus relations assemble nested export. Repeated rows use stable UUIDs, not row numbers.
rules.calculation: Only registered operators/formulas/scripts execute. Narrative is never eval or parsed as a numeric rule.
rules.worlds: No default seasons/months/days or real-world unit ratios invented.
rules.read_only: Table-level derived dominates common and business field access.
rules.provenance: Every source field keeps exact JSON pointer and full source description.

parameter_registry_policy.extension_policy: New registration declarations require validated existing field binding or an explicitly installed value provider. No unbound proposal becomes a current parameter.

parameter_registry_policy.scope_permissions: Use source record and field metadata, no promotion of access by registry reference.

inherited_contract.registration_forms_dependency: Registration contract reads the current effective parameter catalog from this file. Pairing hashes belong to the workbook layout and artifact manifest, avoiding a contract dependency cycle.

source_manifest_contract.verification: Actual UTF8 source byte digest, complete continuous chunk count and ordered concatenated digest all match before entry_hash/total_chunks are populated. No manifest means partial/unknown completeness, not success.
